notes: Baseline emitter composition remains valuable for retrofit quantity CAPEX procurement and transition-path weighting.
Current HET 70/55 C proves record-level current calculation evidence can exist. It is not a required national baseline dimension.
P65 derives record/project supply temperature from post-state room heat loads emitter identity/dimensions/output correction and hydraulic design. Worst-room requirement controls common supply.
Field monitoring shows floor radiator and mixed systems have overlapping but different heating curves and mean temperatures; operating temperature is dynamic.
EHI explicitly states water temperature is not an emitter-specific feature but depends on building/system design and operation.

Q-B02-004 no longer requires a separately observed national baseline design-temperature distribution. It requires emitter-population calibration and population weighting of P65-compatible transition outputs for COP and retrofit planning.
